title: Australian Sardine Tagliere
description: A simple, flavorful dish that combines the rich taste of sardines with the freshness of Australian ingredients.

ingredients.name: Whole Australian Sardines in Olive Oil

instructions: 2. Slice the whole wheat bread into 1cm thick slices.
3. Place the slices on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
4. Bake in the oven for 5 minutes or until lightly toasted.
5. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
6. Open the sardines and drain the liquid.
7. Place the sardines on top of the toasted bread slices.
8. Crumbling the feta cheese, sprinkle it over the sardines.
9. Squeeze a bit of lemon juice over the top.
10. Season with black pepper to taste.
